instruction: Provide steps to set up the Prettier - Code formatter extension in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the Prettier extension (esbenp.prettier-vscode) in VS Code. Evaluator checks if the extension is installed by running 'code --list-extensions' and verifying the output contains 'esbenp.prettier-vscode'. No custom functions needed - reuses existing is_extension_installed metric and vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter executes 'code --list-extensions' which outputs all installed VS Code extensions
Metric is_extension_installed performs string containment check for 'esbenp.prettier-vscode' in the output
Expected value 'esbenp.prettier-vscode' is the correct extension ID for Prettier - Code formatter
Data flow is semantically correct: command output (string) -> containment check (string in string) -> pass/fail
Complete coverage: instruction asks to install Prettier, evaluator verifies it's installed
